exec echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/kgs/find_key.py && grep -q argparse /tmp/kgs/find_key.py && echo LIVENESS-$(date -u +%H:%M:%S) && echo SWEEPER:$(pgrep -af sweep_fixed | tr '\n' ' ') && echo GAMEPID:$(adb -s 127.0.0.1:5555 shell pidof jp.konami.pesam | tr -d '\r') && echo DISK:$(du -sh /tmp/kgs/sweep | cut -f1) && echo FLOWS:$(grep -c '^### ' /tmp/kgs/flows.log) && echo ---RUN--- && timeout 1500 python3 /tmp/kgs/find_key.py --dir /tmp/kgs/sweep --flows /tmp/kgs/flows.log ; echo FINDER-RC:$? ; echo ---END---
